model.title: Providing for the condemnation and denouncement of socialism in all its forms, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Financial Services Committee, House Administration · Rep. Jeff Crank (R-CO)

summary.text: The resolution would express the House's opposition to socialism in all its forms, including the Democratic Socialists of America organization, and would call for rejecting socialist policies in the United States. It would also reaffirm support for free and fair elections, call for passage of the SAVE America Act, assert that only American citizens should vote in U.S. elections, and recommit the House to upholding the Constitution.
